description: The fatal read arm again, from the other direction: a stored row one byte WIDER than app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy declares. The guard is a width equality and not a lower bound, so 301 bytes is refused exactly as 122 was, and the program takes the same ELSE arm at app/cbl/CBACT01C.cbl:L109-L114 with the same three lines and the same RETURN-CODE 12. Stated separately from case13 because a decoder that read the first 300 bytes and ignored the rest would pass that one and fail this one.

expectedMessages.text: START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT01C
